_note: Once the walks are done, a component with a {@render} tag may not also use slots: a <slot> element (not counted for customElement components) or a $$slots reference (counted everywhere). The error points at the latest <slot> of the first slot name seen, else at the first `$$slot` in the source, and comes after mixed_event_handler_syntaxes. Verified against svelte-check 4.4.6.
